description: Authenticates your domain so Pleased.com can send support emails from your address through SendGrid. Adds the empleased return path CNAME (which carries SPF) and two DKIM CNAMEs; existing SPF, MX and DKIM records of other email senders are not changed.
variableDescription: sendgridhost: SendGrid account host (e.g. u1234567.wl123); dkim1, dkim2: DKIM selectors (e.g. s1, s2)
